name: Give specific feedback
short_description: Describe one observed behaviour, its impact, and one feasible next action without judging the person.
self_assessment: I can give feedback with one observation, one impact, and one next action without help.
description: Describe one observed behaviour, its impact, and one feasible next action without judging the person. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Give feedback after a practice presentation
